//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Villager Death Messages -> Config

Enable Villager Death Messages.//: Whether Villager Death Messages is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

showLocation.//: If enabled, shows the location of the villager in the death message.

mentionModdedVillagers.//: If enabled, also shows death messages of modded villagers. If you've found a 'villager'-entity that isn't named let me know by opening an issue so I can add it in.
